subject: planner: Fix the issue where any(nil) is not considered equal to nil (#57428)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent (scoped to expression/planner). The change makes multiple `Equals(any)` implementations nil-safe for typed-nil pointers wrapped in interfaces by asserting to pointer types and explicitly handling nil receiver/other, preventing panics and aligning nil==nil behavior; tests updated accordingly. No remaining Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, consistency, concurrency, privilege, session/txn, or protocol/runtime issues found in the touched planner/expression behavior. Later history up to `upstream/master` shows no follow-up changes to these new `Equals` patterns.
